group: Round 6 · Loot: item icons and pickup kit (loaded by the game)
title: Loot kit: rarity frames, badges, beam and drachmas
use: Inventory tile frames per rarity, the NEW badge, the upgrade arrows, the loot beam and ground glint, and the drachma pickups (loot-design.md, pickup feedback).
prompt: A game interface kit sheet in the blocky voxel style of Minecraft Dungeons, laid out in a clean grid with generous space between elements. Top row: five empty square inventory tile frames, chunky bevelled pixel-art borders with an inner glow: plain parchment grey (common), turquoise (rare), violet (heroic), orange-gold (legendary) and gold with tiny radiating sparkles (blessed); the orange-gold one has small Greek-key corners. Second row: a small rounded yellow badge with a white star burst (no letters), a bold green upward arrow and a red downward arrow in chunky pixel art, a gold star (favourite), and a wide ribbon banner in orange and gold for a legendary find (left blank). Third row: a tall soft vertical light beam texture fading to transparent at the top, drawn in white so it can be tinted; a round ground glint ring of light, white; a four-point twinkle sparkle sprite, white. Bottom row: one golden drachma coin (an owl stamped on it) in voxel style, a small stack of five drachmas, and a bulging coin pouch. Flat solid magenta #FF00FF background with no gradient or shadow so it can be keyed out. Palette: camp orange #f28c28, sea teal #0f6f73, deep navy #10233d, jade #2e8b6e, coral #e8664a, bronze gold #c9963a, lightning yellow #ffd84a, parchment cream #f4ead5, vase black #17130f and owl grey #8c96a3. No lettering, logos, captions or watermark.
generation_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Generate a new game asset sheet. Attached images are references in this order: vox-key, vox-hud, icons-weapons-1. vox-key establishes 3D voxel construction and palette; vox-hud establishes the game aesthetic only, do not copy its background or borders. Other sheets establish consistent subjects and materials.
